# Bootstrap 5.3.8

Unmodified compiled distribution assets, bundled for offline runtime use.

- CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- JS (includes Popper): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/bootstrap/v5.3.8/LICENSE

The application references these local files. Source-map comments in the vendor
files are development metadata; source maps are not required for runtime.
